requirements: While mode is blocked_procedural_default, the prepared ORIGINAL v1 production loader must not be reachable from src/main.ts.
The live registry must continue to default to the clean procedural character while promotion is blocked.
The prepared loader may contain only the exact product-relative production paths and must reject arbitrary/candidate/remote paths.
The only supported activation mode is original_v1_active, and it is valid only after ORIGINAL_V1_PROMOTION_CONTRACT.json is approved_for_promotion.

In original_v1_active mode the dressed bundled ORIGINAL-v1 source must be reachable from src/main.ts, registered by the live registry and be the runtime default; the procedural source remains registered as a diagnostic fallback.
Activation must be a reviewed code change with runtime/default-character tests, not a configuration-only switch.
note: This contract guards both the current dormant cutover and the exact future activation shape. The mode remains blocked_procedural_default until production approval; adding active-mode audit support does not activate or approve the model.
